Card Q&A.a: No, you can't. You can only specify 1 Digimon that will gain  from among multiple Digimon that were played at the same time.
Card Q&A.q: When effects play multiples of my Tokens and/or Digimon with the [Puppet] trait, can I use this card's [Your Turn] effect to give  to all of the played Digimon by suspending this Tamer?

Effect: [Start of Your Turn] If you have 2 or less memory, set it to 3.
[Your Turn] When effects play any of your Tokens or [Puppet] trait Digimon, by suspending this Tamer, 1 of those Digimon gains ＜Rush＞ for the turn. (This Digimon can attack the turn it was played.)
Security Effect: [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
